_note: Hand-tuned placeholder calibration. No fit-calibration corpus exists yet; these values are a guess set to close the degenerate failure mode where 5-inlier PnP "results" reach the client with placeholder confidence 0.5. The loose tolerance model is a 1-feature logistic on log1p(num_inliers) with weight 1.2 and intercept -5.5, gating at loose_min=0.25 (≈ 38 inliers). The tight model copies the loose one; tight_min=0.0 keeps the tight gate a no-op until tolerance-specific features can be fit. sigma_meas_alpha=1.0 preserves PnP's covariance shape; sigma_meas_beta=1.0e-3 floors translation σ at ~3 cm and rotation σ at ~1.8°, so the client's innovation gate corresponds to ~14 cm translation or ~7.4° rotation single-axis residual. Replace via `uv run fit-calibration` against a real ground-truthed capture corpus before relying on either tolerance gate. pipeline_version stays the `placeholder` sentinel — these values are not pipeline-dependent (no map-feature weights), so the LOCALIZER_SHA check disarms correctly.
